links.outcome: CBC results within 52 hours of alert display, plus secondary safety outcomes, in randomized pilot
links.effect: CBC results within 52 hours 1.54 vs 1.82 (P<0.01), a 15% relative reduction in repetitive testing, without adverse effect on secondary safety outcomes.
links.quote: The results show a significant decrease in the number of CBC results within 52 hours of SmartAlert display (1.54 vs. 1.82; P<0.01) without adverse effect on secondary safety outcomes, representing a 15% relative reduction in repetitive testing.

screen.reason: Evaluates a real-world randomized controlled pilot of deploying an ML-driven clinical decision support alert to reduce unnecessary repeat inpatient laboratory tests.
